headline: APPLE CAPS BUG BOUNTY AFTER AI SLOP
subhead: A real macOS root-access flaw worth up to $200K went unreported.
poster_story: Apple capped its bug-bounty submissions after a flood of AI-generated reports with hallucinated vulnerabilities clogged human review, and Italian security firm Bynario could not then file a genuine macOS Screen Sharing root-privilege flaw its CEO values at $100,000 to $200,000
